study: Independent same-Ganzhi same-direction persistence across nonoverlapping periods
scope: Research only; no production calendar/statistics/API/trading changes. Parse frozen raw OHLC and calendar independently; do not import previous research analysis.
data: Real repository Binance BTCUSDT spot UTC+8 daily candles, actual valid 2017 start to2026-10-20 latest closed; original anomalies/listing/unclosed/invalid previous-close rules. Same source hash as earlier data, not earlier conclusions.
annual_rolling: At each2021..2026 Jan1, train previous3complete calendar years; validate that calendar year (2026partial). Overlapping training periods; exploratory separate multiplicity family, not independent replications.
direction: sign(C-O) and sign(C-prior C) separate. Flat included in n. Decimal comparisons. Majority direction chosen on train only; exact tie ->no prediction. Integer100*k >= threshold*n. All60 rows exported per split/basis. Freeze direction and membership during validation.
main_endpoints: 3train thresholds x3validation thresholds x3splits x2basis =54 continued-count endpoints per null;4nulls=216 jointly Holm. Count is primary; ratio and exact-N conditional counts secondary, separately corrected216.

null_methods.year_weekday: IID shuffle full return bundles only within calendar-year x weekday strata; exact annual and weekday direction totals; breaks local serial order.
null_methods.year_weekday_regime: IID within year x weekday x causal lagged bull/bear/sideways/unknown. Keeps state-specific rates exactly; conditional test with original state covariates, not a reconstructed price path.
null_methods.week_block28: Within each calendar year permute complete28-calendar-day Monday-start blocks with all valid dates; leave partial/invalid blocks fixed. Exact year/weekday totals; retains within-block runs and magnitude clustering; cross-block links break.
null_methods.weekly_rotation: Within year rotate the ordered complete valid Monday-Sunday weeks by random whole-week offset, independent offsets per year; incomplete and invalid weeks fixed. Exact year/weekday totals, most long sequences retained except seams/gaps. Not one global60-label relabel.

null_execution: 19999 simulations/method/basis. In EVERY trial rerun train selection and frozen-direction test counting for every split and threshold. Validation-only fixed-real-training-direction group inference also computed from same randomized validation outcomes. Shuffle indices represent return/sign/magnitude bundles; do not reconstruct false OHLC paths.
null_audit: Check every mapping preserves validity/calendar-year/weekday and exact sign counts within strata; regime null additionally keeps causal regime. Report fraction preserved neighboring calendar links, lag1 sign and absolute-return correlation on sampled trials, distribution support. Unit test that global Ganzhi phase shift merely relabels and preserves persistence counts; do not use that invalid null.
empirical_p: (1+number null statistic >= observed)/(B+1), one-sided excess persistence; MonteCarlo Wilson interval for tail probability. Pearson/Spearman positive association tails; negative association not interpreted as persistence.
individual_tests: For all60 train-majority directions per main split, test validation success count vs randomized validation only holding actual trained direction fixed. Family3splits x2basis x60groups x4methods=1440 Holm; also show within-method360 and primary-split120 diagnostic correction. No selective testing only case-study winners.
benchmark: Same validation BTC up/down baseline and year x weekday matched leave-one-Ganzhi-out baseline. Display raw k/n, exact sign totals, pointwise Wilson rate intervals. Calendar60-day block bootstrap5000 reps for per-group validation-rate and baseline-excess95% intervals; recompute matched leave-group-out benchmark in each draw.
correlations: Pearson and Spearman for raw up-rate train/test, frozen train-majority success train/test, and frozen selected55/60/65 cohorts. 5cohorts x2stats x3splits x2basis=60 per null, Holm across240. Spearman ties average ranks; too few/constant ->unavailable, not0 significant.
classification: Train55 candidates: persistent validation>=55; strong>=60; high>=65; reversal validation<50; marked reversal<=40. These descriptive labels do not themselves prove significance.
year_regime: Export annual counts and per-candidate validation-year/regime success. Causal regime uses only previous valid common close vs trailing200close mean and90-observation return +/-10%; unknown before200 historical closes.
occurrence_windows: For each Ganzhi, at every eligible occurrence use previous30 occurrences; select if same direction has>=18/30 successes, then freeze side for next10/20/30 occurrences. Only full future horizon allowed. Also fixed nonoverlap anchors30,30+H,..., whether or not prior anchor selected. All overlapping windows explicitly correlated.
rolling_null: Repeat entire past30>=60% selection under all4nulls. Primary metric future success minus matched year-weekday BTC expectation;2basis x2supported horizons x2anchor policies x4nulls=32 Holm if horizons10/20 supported. Export horizon30 unavailable when no60-occurrence history. Hit rates/counts secondary descriptive.
survival: S1 frozen train55 pool, cumulative same-direction validation success at1,5,10,15,20,24,30 future occurrences; no horizon selection; insufficient future horizons marked unavailable.
limits: Previously examined historical source and user-named cases are exploratory, not fresh confirmation. Main split disjoint train/test, but different splits overlap each other and nulls share data; never multiply as independent evidence. No EV/volatility/PnL model recommendation.
